state: After Inspect backup folder on the backup made for the previous scene: the 'Restore preview' section with the confirmation checkbox UNTICKED and Restore on next launch disabled. Do not schedule a restore.

alt: The Restore scheduled panel with the instruction to close and reopen CueRithm and the Cancel scheduled restore button
caption: A scheduled restore waits for the next start and can be cancelled until then.
state: Capture only on a disposable library or accept the risk: tick the confirmation, choose Restore on next launch, capture the 'Restore scheduled' panel, then immediately choose Cancel scheduled restore. Never quit CueRithm while a restore is scheduled on the real library.
needs: Prefer a disposable library (CUERITHM_DATA_DIR) for this scene.
